mapper.select: select mn.* from Sec_Expert_Check_Dtl mn where mn.Ec_Id=#{id} order by mn.Secd_Sort asc

select mn.*, srd.*, sf.file_relation_id, mn.id as ec_id from Sec_Expert_Check mn left join Sec_Selection_Record_Dtl srd on srd.Sr_Id=mn.Sr_Id left join sys_file sf on sf.FileId = mn.id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on mn.Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id where mn.id=#{id} limit 1

select secd.*, mn.*, se.*, secd.id as scdId, mn.srd_id as srdId, mn.sr_Id as srId, se.ex_id as exId, ec.id as ecId from Sec_Selection_Record_Dtl mn join Sec_Expert_Check ec on ec.Sr_Id=mn.Sr_Id join Sec_Expert se on mn.Ex_Id=se.Ex_Id left join Sec_Expert_Check_Detail secd on secd.ec_id=ec.id and secd.srd_id=mn.srd_id where ec.id=#{id}

select c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as exContrAbbName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, mn.*, se.* from Sec_Selection_Record_Dtl mn left join Sec_Expert se on mn.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = se.C_Id where mn.Sr_Id = #{srId}

select c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as exContrAbbName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, mn.*, se.* from Sec_Selection_Record_Dtl mn left join Sec_Expert se on mn.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = se.C_Id where mn.Sr_Id = #{srId}

select mn.sr_id, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Remark as secRemark, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Evaluate_Separation as secEvaluateSeparation, sec.Sec_Quali_Review as secQualiReview, sec.Sec_Bid_Time as secBidTime, sec.Sec_Loaction as secLoaction, sec.Sec_Investors_Quali as secInvestorsQuali, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Section_Classify as secSectionClassify, mn.sr_Create_Uid as examineUid, mn.sr_Create_Uname as examineUname, mn.sr_Create_Time as ecTime, mn.sr_Mode as seMode, mn.Sr_Bid_Time as ecAssessTime from Sec_Selection_Record mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = sec.Sec_Agency left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id = mn.Sr_Company where mn.Sr_Id = #{srId}
